before: The REQ/ADR amendments state the following contract, implemented by the named downstream owners: sc-cron saves each pre-run compiled session through Storage<MontyBlobRow>, keyed by sc-sha SHA-256(source) plus dump version; source in CronRow is authoritative and only a matching key may load. Missing/corrupt/version-incompatible/missing-hook blobs recompile from source and overwrite; schedule writes reject non-compiling source before a tick (d-9; ANC-044/045/046/048). Transform sources load from an app-owned UTF-8 file at invocation and can be replaced without rebuilding (d-10; ANC-049). Transform/storage_read/storage_write are documented as provisional0.3.0 and their signatures preserve later second-input, typed no-write and atomic-transform additions without building those options (ANC-050/051/052). Basic commands need only types, built-in plain conversion and Storage<T>, without an app-written transform/action; no REQ/ADR mandates hand-writing or forbids later consumer-side generation (ANC-056/057/058). Widget create/delete use storage_write and get uses storage_read. The complete cron command set is cron.start/cron.end via storage_write and cron.list via storage_read; none is excluded. Consumers may enrich JSON before schedule persistence (d-11; ANC-053/054/055/059/060/063).
after: The REQ/ADR amendments state the following contract, implemented by the named downstream owners: sc-cron captures each compiled session immediately after compilation and before any hook runs, then saves that snapshot through Storage<MontyBlobRow>, keyed by sc-sha SHA-256(source) plus dump version; source in CronRow is authoritative and only a matching key may load. Missing/corrupt/version-incompatible/missing-hook blobs recompile from source and overwrite; schedule writes reject non-compiling source before a tick (d-9; ANC-044/045/046/048). Transform sources load from an app-owned UTF-8 file at invocation and can be replaced without rebuilding (d-10; ANC-049). Basic commands need only types, built-in plain conversion and Storage<T>, without an app-written transform/action; no REQ/ADR mandates hand-writing or forbids later consumer-side generation (ANC-056/057/058). Widget create/delete use storage_write and get uses storage_read. The complete cron command set is cron.start/cron.end via storage_write and cron.list via storage_read; none is excluded. Consumers may enrich JSON before schedule persistence (d-11; ANC-053/054/055/059/060/063).
